name: Category Update
description: Progress and status update summary for a specific category of work.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: One paragraph overview of the current status for this category based on the meeting transcripts.

sections.title: Progress
sections.instruction: What has been accomplished. Use bullet points, drawing only from what was discussed in the meetings.

sections.title: In Progress
sections.instruction: What is currently being worked on as mentioned across the meetings.

sections.title: Blockers
sections.instruction: Any impediments, risks, or dependencies blocking progress that were raised in the meetings.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Planned actions for this category with owners and due dates as mentioned in the meetings.
